corrected_ab.description: Corrected A/B intervention analysis. Treatment unit is the batch pair (n=30 trials, 3 seeds × 10 trials). Seed-clustered SEs and hierarchical bootstrap account for nested structure. Sign-flip test uses seed-level means (3 units).

batch_balance.note: Batches are not relation-matched. HIGH and LOW differ in semantic composition.

hierarchical_bootstrap.method: Hierarchical bootstrap: resample seeds (with replacement), then trials within each resampled seed (with replacement).

sign_flip_test.note: With 3 seeds, exact test has 8 sign patterns. All 3 negative → p = 1/8 = 0.125.

dose_response.note: Trial-level correlation (n=30). Modest expected because the design compares discrete HIGH vs LOW, not a continuous gradient.

predictor_correlations.note: CLaRE mean-cosine and our max-cosine are computed from the same key vectors and differ only in aggregation (mean vs max). High correlation is expected and confirms they measure the same underlying quantity: representation overlap at the edit layer.
